rows.english: We'll guide you where you need to go, Bi Xi.
rows.turkish: Seni gitmen gereken yere yönlendireceğiz, Bi Xi.

rows.english: All we need to do is deliver an ancient tablet to a sleeping dragon? Easy.
rows.turkish: Tek yapmamız gereken kadim bir tableti uyuyan bir ejderhaya teslim etmek mi? Kolay.

rows.english: Franklin and Val are going to be so sad that they missed this!
rows.turkish: Frankin ve Val bunu kaçırdıkları için çok üzülecek!

rows.english: Careful. Strange is at it again…
rows.turkish: Dikkatli olun. Strange yine yapacağını yaptı…

rows.english: I could be in and out of here with no one ever noticing…
And this is why I always take the Fantasti-Car…
rows.turkish: İşte bu yüzden hep Fantasti-Car’ı kullanırım…

rows.english: All eyes over here.
Invisible and invincible!
Guns aren't toys, Frank. Especially ones that big.
rows.turkish: Silahlar oyuncak değildir Frank. Özellikle de o kadar büyük silahlar.

rows.english: I shut down Rocket's beacon.
Can we just focus on what we're doing here?
Khonshu's going to be very angry…
Clear the way!
I'm not healing.
That's much better.
How about I switch things up and make our opponents disappear?
rows.turkish: İşleri tersine çevirip biraz da düşmanlarımızı ortadan kaldırayım mı?

rows.english: Our Steve was the glue that held together countless teams of heroes. Trust me, you were born for this.
rows.turkish: Bizim tanıdığımız Steve, pek çok kahraman takımını bir arada tutan insandı. Sen bana güven. Bu iş için doğmuşsun.

rows.english: A S.H.I.E.L.D. transport? Not invisible, but inconspicious I guess.
rows.turkish: S.H.I.E.L.D.'in bir nakliye aracı mı? Görünmez değil ama pek dikkat çekmiyor sanırım.

rows.english: Not at all. But in most realities, these are some of our closest allies.
rows.turkish: Hiç de bile. Ancak bu insanlar, çoğu gerçeklikte bizim en yakın müttefiklerimiz.

rows.english: Your father would have been proud, Elsa.
If anyone can do this, it's you, H.E.R.B.I.E.
rows.turkish: Bu işi başarabilecek birisi varsa o da sensin H.E.R.B.I.E.

rows.english: We are who we are, Reed. The Fantastic Four. That will never change.
rows.turkish: Biz buyuz Reed. Fantastik Dörtlü. Bu durum asla değişmeyecek.

rows.english: No need to worry.
Didn't see that coming.
That outcome was crystal clear from the beginning.
rows.turkish: Bunun olacağı başından beri gün gibi netti.

rows.english: Vortex field!
Come on. Let me heal you.
I'm sorry.
This place is worth a good look.
I promise we'll finish this, Ororo. From one Storm to another.
rows.turkish: Sana söz veriyorum, bu işi bitireceğiz Ororo. Storm sözü.

rows.english: Even my power has its limits… but for all intents and purposes, yes.
rows.turkish: Benim gücümün bile sınırları var… ama tüm niyet ve amaçlar için, evet.

rows.english: I need a hand over here.
Sorry. You made this mess, Spector.
Don't kid yourself, Namor. The darker the depths, the more they'll thrive.
rows.turkish: Kendini kandırma Namor. Asıl okyanusun kapkara derinliklerinde günlerini gün ederler.

rows.english: Do any of them have the ability to turn invisible? Because I find that makes a huge difference…
rows.turkish: Aralarında görünmez olabilen var mı? Çünkü bence bu, farkı bayağı büyütüyor…

rows.english: I'll make it through.
It's up to us to end this. For Wakanda's sake!
rows.turkish: Bu işi bitirmek bize düşer. Wakanda’nın iyiliği için!

rows.english: I'll be sure to remember that… and when it does, I'll be ready.
rows.turkish: Bunu bir kenara yazayım… O gün geldiğinde hazır olacağım.

rows.english: Needed that more than you know.
Feel the pull!
Literally anything.
Don't worry. I've got you covered in that department.
Force burst!
Yes. And before you ask: It's never going to happen.
I prefer teams of four… but I can make this work.
rows.turkish: Dörtlü takımları tercih ederim… Ama bu işi yürütebiliriz.

rows.english: I warned you not to play with guns, Frank.
rows.turkish: Seni silahla oyun olmaz diye uyarmıştım Frank.

rows.english: Here's the spot to attack!
No one gets past this point!
Five? Fantastic!
Hang on for just a while…
You'll have to let this mom stretch first, but then you're on!
rows.turkish: Önce biraz esnememe fırsat verirsen bana uyar!

rows.english: Castle's turret is out of service.
I'm at maximum force.
Currently, I'm more interested in fighting against our common foes.
rows.turkish: Şu an ortak düşmanlarımızla dövüşmekle daha çok ilgileniyorum.

rows.english: We can always count on you, Spidey.
I understand, Bucky. Some villains just don't know when to quit.
rows.turkish: Seni anlıyorum Bucky. Bazı kötüler bir türlü pes etmedi gitti.

rows.english: Which Doom?
Sniper located and eliminated.
rows.turkish: Keskin nişancıyı buldum ve ortadan kaldırdım.

rows.english: Let's take this area.
No. But I'm keeping a thin force field around my entire body at all times.
rows.turkish: Hayır. Ama tüm vücudumu daima ince bir güç alanıyla sarıyorum.

rows.english: It's Richards, Namor. As you are well aware.
rows.turkish: Namor, soyadım Richards. Bunu sen de gayet iyi biliyorsun.

rows.english: Then we play to our strengths. I'll strike when they least expect it…
rows.turkish: O hâlde kendi güçlü yönlerimizi kullanalım. Onların hiç beklmediği anda saldıracağım…

rows.english: Need to find that sniper…
Victory may be hard to see, Zero, but it's getting closer.
rows.turkish: Zaferi görmek zor olsa da az kaldı Zero.

rows.english: We'll do this the same way we always do. Together.
rows.turkish: Bu işi daima olduğu gibi birlikte yapacağız.

rows.english: We strike as a team.
It was an honor to serve alongside you, Cap.
We have to keep pushing. This realm needs us!
rows.turkish: İlerlemeye devam etmeliyiz. Bu diyarın bize ihtiyacı var!

rows.english: Really? Me? But you're one of the best spies in the world, Natasha.
rows.turkish: Gerçekten mi? Ben mi? Ama sen dünyanın en iyi casuslarından birisin Natasha.

rows.english: Come on! If Knull rises, it's all over.
rows.turkish: Hadi! Knull güç kazanırsa her şey biter.

rows.english: Think you're tough, Logan? I can see straight through you.
rows.turkish: Kendini çetin ceviz mi sanıyorsun Logan? Senin içini görüyorum.

rows.english: And this is why I chose Reed, Namor…
rows.turkish: İşte bu yüzden Reed’i seçtim Namor…

rows.english: Stand clear so Zero can get through!
I'm not as well as I hoped.
Sue Richards, ready to help.
Won't last much longer…
What do you think, Ororo? Do we go in full force or stay under the radar?
rows.turkish: Ne dersin Ororo? Var gücümüzle saldıralım mı yoksa gizlice mi ilerleyelim?

rows.english: We'll make it to Budokan, Zero. I promise.
I've got you covered.
Where were you when vampires were taking over New York, Blade?
rows.turkish: New York'u vampirler ele geçirirken neredeydin, Blade?

rows.english: Disappear!
Let's hope those goats are ready to go…
rows.turkish: Umarım şu keçiler yola çıkmaya hazırdır…

rows.english: I won't disappear so easily.
I won't let you down, H.E.R.B.I.E. I promise.
rows.turkish: Seni hayal kırıklığına uğratmayacağım H.E.R.B.I.E. Söz veriyorum.

rows.english: Leave it to T'Challa to rise above his fellow man… literally…
rows.turkish: T'Challa yine herkesin ötesine yükselmiş… Her açıdan…

rows.english: We aren't giving up this area.
Even when the Multiverse is in danger, family still comes first.
rows.turkish: Çoklu Evren tehlikede olduğunda bile aile her şeyden önce gelir.

rows.english: I found their play area.
If Reed sees this place, he's never going to leave!
rows.turkish: Reed burayı görürse geri dönmek istemeyecek!

rows.english: Feeling fantastic!
These little robots may be a problem…
Keep moving it forward!
There's more of them than us.
Another fearsome foe.
We've got trouble.
The outcome was clear.
You left the door open, Stephen…
You're grounded.
I appreciate you looking out for me, dear, but I'm not about to miss the final battle.
rows.turkish: Beni düşünmene sevindim canım ama son savaşı kaçıracak değilim.

rows.english: One, two, three!
Hmm. Such curious little spiders…
rows.turkish: Hımm. Ne acayip minik örümcekler bunlar…

rows.english: We can't afford to slow down.
You know you're always safe with me, H.E.R.B.I.E.
Anyone else up for saving an empire?
Thought you wouldn't see me again?
rows.turkish: Beni bir daha görmeyeceğini mi sandın?

rows.english: I'm starting to think Fisk may actually be worse for New York than Dracula was…
rows.turkish: Fisk’in New York için Drakula’dan bile daha kötü olabileceğini düşünmeye başlıyorum…

rows.english: Clear the way!
Enemy located.
Reed? You do have a plan to stop Victor, don't you darling?
rows.turkish: Reed? Victor’u durdurmak için bir planın vardır, değil mi canım?

rows.english: Force burst!
You know me, Johnny. When I'm needed, I'm there.
rows.turkish: Beni bilirsin Johnny. Bana ihtiyaç duyanı yarı yolda bırakmam.

rows.english: This core is the only thing that can stop Ultron.
rows.turkish: Ultron'u durdurabilecek tek şey bu çekirdek.

rows.english: It's time to go on the offensive.
Not sure how we'll solve this without you, Tony…
rows.turkish: Bu işi sensiz nasıl çözeriz bilemedim Tony…

rows.english: It's getting you to stop talking about yourself that's the real trick.
rows.turkish: Asıl zor olan, kendin hakkında konuşmayı bırakmanı sağlamak.

rows.english: An extra force field? Great!
rows.turkish: Fazladan bir güç alanı mı? Harika!

rows.english: Why couldn't Galactus have consumed THIS planet…
rows.turkish: Galactus neden BU gezegeni tüketmedi ki…

rows.english: They're sneaking from behind!
A sniper. But where…?
Still the best at what you do, Logan.
rows.turkish: Hâlâ bu işte senden iyisi yok Logan.

rows.english: Quit keeping tabs on my kids, White Fox.
Out of sight!
That was a total blindside!
I took apart that turret, for all of our safety.
rows.turkish: Hepimizin güvenliği için tareti paramparça ettim.

rows.english: I need you to promise me you'll show some restraint out there, Johnny.
rows.turkish: Oraya çıktığımızda biraz kendine hâkim olacağına söz vermeni istiyorum Johnny.

rows.english: I'll be sure to tell him exactly what you said…
We're almost to Avenger Tower. Stay close, H.E.R.B.I.E.!
rows.turkish: Yenilmezler Kulesi’ne geldik sayılır. Yanımdan ayrılma H.E.R.B.I.E.!

rows.english: Be proud of what you did here.
You know, Reed, for someone so brilliant, it's amazing how oblivious you can be…
rows.turkish: Reed, çok zeki adamsın ama bazen aklın öylesine çalışmıyor ki hayret ediyorum…

rows.english: When will the Elders of the Universe learn…?
rows.turkish: Evrenin Kadimleri ne zaman ders alacak…?

rows.english: Not in control here…
As graceful and lethal as always, T'Challa.
rows.turkish: Her zamanki gibi zarif ve ölümcülsün T'Challa.

rows.english: Hmm. I wonder if I could shift the beam's trajectory, the same way I control my force field.
rows.turkish: Hmm. Acaba tıpkı kuvvet alanımı kontrol ettiğim gibi, ışının yörüngesini de değiştirebilir miyim?

rows.english: Our opponents have been here.
I hate to admit it, Namor… but I'm going to miss you…
rows.turkish: Bunu itiraf etmek hoşuma gitmese de… Seni özleyeceğim Namor…

rows.english: Well, from one mother to another, let me say, you are a true gem.
rows.turkish: Ben de anne olduğum için şunu demek istedim. Elmas gibi kadınsın gerçekten.

rows.english: What's the delay? Do we want to end up in cages, too?
rows.turkish: Bu gecikme de ne? Biz de kafeslere tıkılmak mı istiyoruz?

rows.english: Don't let them through!
You never fail to impress me, Reed.
rows.turkish: Her seferinde beni etkilemeyi başarıyorsun Reed.

rows.english: Someone is aiming for us…
Whoever did this isn't going to stop after a single Celestial…
rows.turkish: Bunu yapan kişi bir SEMAVİ ile yetinmeyecek…

rows.english: You think this is a challenge? Try raising two super-powered kids.
rows.turkish: Bu işi zor mu sanıyorsunuz? Süper güçlü iki çocuk yetiştirmeyi deneyin.

rows.english: Johnny! No! I'll make them pay for this!
Some things you just can't unsee…
Well, in that case… we'll just have to wait and see…
rows.turkish: Hımm, o zaman bekle de gör bakalım…

rows.english: I'm taking less damage.
Was that supposed to be a compliment?
Wow. Are your motivations always as transparent as I am?
rows.turkish: Vay be. Asıl amacın hep benim kadar saydam mıdır?

rows.english: I'm the Invincible Woman now!
I've been told that before. But that kind of violence isn't really my style.
rows.turkish: Bunu daha önce de duymuştum ancak o tarz şiddet uygulamak hiç tarzım değil.

rows.english: Oh, hello.
Is it really Clobberin' Time already, Ben?
rows.turkish: Dayak Zamanı şimdiden geldi mi Benjamin?

rows.english: These squids reek of desperation, Namor…
Let's get this done.
A magic ankh? Hmm…
rows.turkish: Büyülü bir yaşam çarmıhı mı? Hımm…

rows.english: We need to keep it safe here.
Follow us, Zero.
The sniper's down. We're clear.
You pulled your punches, Ben. Big mistake.
rows.turkish: Tüm gücünü kullanmadın Benjy. Büyük hata.

rows.english: You asked for it.
They look like they mean business.
No worries. I've got your back.
I turned Rocket's amp down to zero.
It's up to us to finally end this night! Let's go!
rows.turkish: Bu geceye nihayet son vermek bize düşer! Hadi gidelim!

rows.english: I've visited countless dimensions… but this place never fails to impress…
rows.turkish: Sayısız boyut ziyaret ettim ama burası insanı etkilemeyi daima başarıyor…

rows.english: They'll never see me coming…
The Invisible Woman is here.
Pick up your toys, Moon Knight…
A clear winner.
They're never going to see us coming, Reed!
The Collector has gone too far. These creatures deserve to be free.
rows.turkish: Koleksiyoncu iyice zıvanadan çıktı. Bu yaratıklar özgür olmayı hak ediyor.

rows.english: After all these years, saving the world still hasn't gotten old.
rows.turkish: Bunca yıla rağmen dünyayı kurtarmaktan hâlâ bıkmadım.

rows.english: It has been a while since I've done a solo mission…
rows.turkish: Tek başıma bir görev yapalı uzun zaman oldu…

rows.english: Everyone, together!
Of course.
My shields are down.
Rrraaaggghhh, did I say "Nice job" right?
rows.turkish: Rrraaaggghhh, “İyi iş” demeyi doğru mu söyledim?

rows.english: I cleared them out.
This is just a normal Tuesday in our family.
rows.turkish: Bizim ailemiz için sıradan bir gün.

rows.english: If anyone could snuff out your flame, Johnny, it'd be me.
rows.turkish: Alevlerini söndürebilecek tek kişi benim Johnny.

rows.english: Now I see them…
We push all the way to Yggdrasill.
Never even saw me coming!
Huh. So this is how Johnny feels…
Was that really it?
Please tell me this isn't the date night you've been planning for us, Reed.
rows.turkish: Umarım ikimiz için planladığın romantik gece bu değildir Reed.

rows.english: Hang out with my husband often enough and you'll get used to it…
Give it a try and everyone here will find out what else I can make disappear…
rows.turkish: Bir dene bakalım, burada herkes başka neleri yok edebileceğimi öğrenecek…

rows.english: Need to strengthen my field…
On the plus side, they can't bite what they can't see…
rows.turkish: En azından beni göremezlerse ısıramazlar da…

rows.english: I still remember some martial arts from my S.H.I.E.L.D. espionage days!
rows.turkish: S.H.I.E.L.D. casusluk günlerimden hâlâ biraz dövüş sanatı hatırlıyorum!

rows.english: Anyone willing to help?
Psionic Burst!
The beacon's signal is cut.
Good news. I got the bots!
Defense is the key.
I may not be an Immortal Weapon, but that won't stop me from fighting!
rows.turkish: Ölümsüz Silah olmayabilirim ama bu, savaşmama engel olamaz!

rows.english: Your reign just came to an end, T'Challa.
More vulnerable than ever.
Thanks so much.
This isn't the time for a slow dance. Pick up the pace!
rows.turkish: Yavaş dans etmenin zamanı değil. Hızlan!

rows.english: Knull could return any moment. We need to move!
rows.turkish: Knull her an geri dönebilir. Harekete geçmemiz lazım!

rows.english: I could help with that… but not in the way I think you mean…
rows.turkish: Sana bu konuda yardım edebilirim… Ama sandığın şekilde değil…

rows.english: I need to heal.
The bug bots have been stomped.
Cosmic rays didn't make me who I am today. My family did.
rows.turkish: Beni ben yapan şey, kozmik ışınlar değil. Ailem.

rows.english: More health is never bad.
No. This just isn't exactly the date night I'd been hoping for…
rows.turkish: Hayır. Umduğum romantik gece tam olarak böyle değildi sadece…

rows.english: I thought we were supposed to be on the same side, Frank.
Someone, help me out.
No! Cyclops is down!
Arakko is in big trouble if we don't start moving!
rows.turkish: Eğer harekete geçmezsek Arakko'nun başı büyük bir belaya girecek!

rows.english: So much for staying under Fisk's radar… But there's no turning back now!
rows.turkish: Fisk’in radarının altında kalmak da yalan oldu… Ama artık geri dönüş yok!

rows.english: You've already saved so many. Even justice needs to rest every now and then.
rows.turkish: Zaten pek çok kişiyi kurtardın. Hatta adalet bile zaman zaman dinlenmeyi hak eder.

rows.english: I don't give up so easily.
We have to stand strong.
All talk, as usual, Deadpool.
rows.turkish: Her zamanki gibi, sadece konuşuyorsun, Deadpool.

rows.english: I'm fine, thanks.
What they're doing here… It's unspeakable!
rows.turkish: Burada yaptıkları şeyler ağza alınır gibi değil!

rows.english: I'll gladly take the win.
No more delays.
We'll bring you justice, Daredevil.
You should've seen that coming.
Please let Moon Girl know that Franklin and Valeria would love to have her over for another playdate soon.
rows.turkish: Lütfen Moon Girl’e, Franklin ve Valeria’nın yakında bir oyun buluşması için onu yine çok görmek istediklerini söyle.

rows.english: It feels good to step outside my bubble every now and then.
rows.turkish: İnsan alıştığı güvenli alanı arada sırada terk etmeli.

rows.english: That's another life down, Cat.
rows.turkish: Bu da bir can daha gitti, Cat.

rows.english: Just board games and fresh baked cookies. And no data from Reed's experiments for her to analyze. I promise.
rows.turkish: Sadece kutu oyunları ve fırından yeni çıkmış kurabiyeler. Reed’in deneylerinden analiz etmesi için veri falan da yok. Söz.

rows.english: Even small victories are worth celebrating.
Spider-bots? I prefer H.E.R.B.I.E. myself…
rows.turkish: Örümcek botlar mı? Şahsen H.E.R.B.I.E.yi tercih ederim…

rows.english: Arakko is a living thing. It deserves to be free from Ultron's influence.
rows.turkish: Arakko yaşayan bir şeydir. Ultron'un etkisinden kurtulmayı hak ediyor.

rows.english: They can't monitor what they can't see…
Should I give them until the count of four to walk away?
rows.turkish: Bu işi bırakmaları için dörde kadar sayayım mı?

rows.english: No.
Stolen artifacts and imprisoned aliens. Not exactly my idea of high culture.
rows.turkish: Çalınmış eserler ve hapsedilmiş uzaylılar. Pek de “yüksek kültür” sayılmaz.

rows.english: Believe it or not, Felicia, some things are more valuable than jewels. Like honesty and self respect.
rows.turkish: İster inan ister inanma, Felicia; bazı şeyler mücevherlerden daha değerlidir. Mesela dürüstlük ve özsaygı.

rows.english: You're on our team now, Zero. Let's do this.
rows.turkish: Artık bizim takımdasın Zero. Hadi yapalım şunu.

rows.english: That's all you had?
I may have been out of sight, but were you out of your mind?
rows.turkish: Ben görünmezim diye seni görmem mi sandın?

rows.english: I count a few too many of them.
Clear the path. We're headed to the World Tree!
Behind you!
A fantastic five!
Don't give up what's ours.
This place is begging to be attacked.
We didn't ask to be heroes, but we always answer the call.
rows.turkish: Kahraman olmayı kendimiz seçmedik ama daima gerekeni yaparız.

rows.english: What a magical place. The children would love it here!
rows.turkish: Ne büyülü bir yer. Çocuklar buraya bayılır!

rows.english: I'll take five!
If we don't get to the castle, the vampires win. That's not an option!
rows.turkish: Şatoya ulaşamazsak vampirler kazanır. Böyle bir seçeneğimiz yok!

rows.english: You needed a time out.
Gather in!
Nice work, Namor. But don't let it go to your head.
rows.turkish: Aferin Namor. Ama çok da havalara girme.

rows.english: Poor creatures. Namor should be ashamed!
I appreciate that. Maybe the Fantastic Four will have to pay your home realm a visit.
rows.turkish: Bunu takdir ediyorum. Belki de Fantastik Dörtlü, senin memleketine bir ziyaret yapmalı.

rows.english: It's clear I'm still needed here.
rows.turkish: Belli ki burada hâlâ bana ihtiyaç var.

rows.english: We're not going to let T'Challa down, are we?
Nice deal, Gambit.
Back when he tried to start his own Age of Ultron. I remember.
rows.turkish: Kendi Ultron Çağını başlatmaya çalıştığı zamanlar. Hatırlıyorum.

rows.english: Reed is glad to have another genius around to help him solve this, Tony.
rows.turkish: Bu işi çözmesine yardım etmek için yanında bir dâhi daha olmasına Reed çok sevindi Tony.

rows.english: I hope this is important. Reed and I had a date night planned…
rows.turkish: Umarım önemli bir sorundur. Reed’le romantik bir gece planlamıştık…

rows.english: That amplifier is off now.
Thanks. Now, would you mind telling my brother that?
rows.turkish: Sağ ol. Şimdi bunu bir de kardeşime söylesen?

rows.english: Yeah I WISH my four doctorates in bio-chem helped me understand Reed…
rows.turkish: Evet, KEŞKE biyokimya alanındaki dört doktoram sayesinde Reed’i anlayabilseydim…

rows.english: Feeling refreshed.
Psionic Surge!
Next?
We were planning to retire on Mars!
I need a bit more power…
Rocket's amp is history.
Everyone saw that. How embarrassing.
rows.turkish: Herkes gördü bunu. Çok utanç verici.

rows.english: You should pay more attention.
Ready to turn up the heat, baby brother?
rows.turkish: Isıyı artırmaya hazır mısın, küçük kardeşim?

rows.english: Of course… but I would also be extremely concerned…
rows.turkish: Elbette… Ama ayrıca son derece endişeli olurum…

rows.english: Well, you'll always be part of ours, Peter. Wherever… and whenever… we may be.
rows.turkish: Sen de daima bizim ailemizin bir parçası olacaksın Peter. Her nerede veya ne zamanda olursak olsun.

rows.english: Your optic beam. That's not light or heat, is it? It's something much more solid…
rows.turkish: Optik ışının. Bu ışık ya da ısı değil, öyle mi? Çok daha katı bir şey…

rows.english: Power like yours can change worlds. I'm glad you decided that it should change them for the better.
rows.turkish: Sahip olduğun güçle dünyaları değiştirebilirsin. Gücünü iyilik için kullanmaya karar vermene sevindim.

rows.english: Flame on!
You're a true powerhouse, Rogue!
rows.turkish: Sen tam bir güç küpüsün, ROGUE!

rows.english: Rest easy, Ben. You've earned it.
rows.turkish: Huzur içinde yat Benjamin. Bunu hak ettin.

rows.english: Rocket's beacon is officially off-line.
All clear.
Hope we won't be seeing that sniper again…
rows.turkish: Umarım şu keskin nişancıyı bir daha görmeyiz…

rows.english: Three in a row!
I'm afraid we're outnumbered.
rows.turkish: Ne yazık ki sayıca bizden çoklar.

rows.english: Stealth mode!
Better watch your back!
I don't like the look of that turret…
Those spider-bots won't be bothering us now.
rows.turkish: Şu örümcek botlar artık bizi rahatsız etmeyecek.

rows.english: I'll put this to good use.
Consider this an irreconcilable difference, Reed.
Time to disappear!
Maybe we should build a statue of H.E.R.B.I.E. outside of the Baxter Building…
rows.turkish: Belki de Baxter Binası’nın dışına H.E.R.B.I.E. için bir heykel dikmeliyiz…

rows.english: Get ready to do some damage.
Let's heat it up!
Reed saves the world countless times each week. Almost as often as you fail to conquer it.
rows.turkish: Reed her hafta dünyayı defalarca kurtarıyor. Neredeyse senin dünyayı fethetmeye çalışıp başaramaman kadar sık.

rows.english: You know, there happen to be men AND women of science in this fight.
rows.turkish: Farkındaysan bu savaşta hem bilim adamları hem de bilim kadınları var.

rows.english: Do you have a license for that thing, Frank?
rows.turkish: Şu şey için ehliyet aldın mı Frank?

rows.english: Namor's alone again. That's for the best…
rows.turkish: Namor yine yalnız kaldı. Böylesi daha iyi…

rows.english: Hold strong! We can do this!
Hitting here could cause massive destruction.
rows.turkish: Buraya saldırırsak muazzam bir yıkıma yol açabiliriz.

rows.english: Well I have reality warping and super genius experience, so call if you ever need an extra hand.
rows.turkish: Eh, gerçekliği bükebilirim ve süper dâhi deneyimim de var; bir gün fazladan bir ele ihtiyacın olursa ara.

rows.english: I'll do my best to carry on, Reed… but it won't be easy…
rows.turkish: Devam etmek için elimden geleni yapacağım Reed… Ama zor olacak…

rows.english: For starters, I have a fantastic support system. Reed, Johnny, Ben, H.E.R.B.I.E.
rows.turkish: Öncelikle, harika bir destek sistemim var. Reed, Johnny, Ben, H.E.R.B.I.E.

rows.english: When we're done here, you're welcome to join us back at the Baxter Building.
rows.turkish: Buradaki işimiz bittiğinde, Baxter Binası'na bize katılmaya davetlisin.

rows.english: My kids fight harder!
It's been so long since I've had a night out. This will have to do…
rows.turkish: Akşamları dışarı çıkmayalı çok uzun zaman olmuştu. Bu seferlik idare edelim bakalım…

rows.english: Sorry. Not stealthy enough, Widow.
rows.turkish: Üzgünüm. Kendini yeterince iyi saklayamadın Widow.

rows.english: A little extra oomph!
Flame shield!
This may be the longest night of my life… at least since the kids were babies…
rows.turkish: Sanırım ömrümün en uzun gecesi bu… En azından çocuklar büyüdüğünden beri…

rows.english: I've always been a heavy hitter.
You've certainly come a long way since the Enclave created you, Adam.
rows.turkish: Enclave seni yarattığından bu yana çok yol katettin Adam.

rows.english: You may have just been unthawed in your timeline, but to us, you were a trusted friend for ages.
rows.turkish: Kendi zaman tünelinde buzdan henüz çıkmış olsan da bizim için yıllardır tanıyıp güvendiğimiz dostumuzsun.

rows.english: Yes.
This place makes me want to stay inside a force field forever…
rows.turkish: Burayı gördükçe sonsuza dek güç alanı içinde kalasım geliyor…

rows.english: Getting close to full force.
What has Victor gotten us into this time…?
rows.turkish: Victor bu kez ne haltlar yemiş?..

rows.english: I'll take a cosmic clash over fighting vampires any day.
rows.turkish: Vampirlerle savaşmaktansa kozmik çatışmaları tercih ederim.

rows.english: One way we get to the finish line, Zero: Together.
rows.turkish: Bitiş çizgisine ulaşmanın tek bir yolu var Zero: Birlikte.

rows.english: Don't make me hurt you.
Home isn't always where the webs are…
Don't worry, Bi Xi! We'll get you and the tablet to Shou-Lao… I hope…
rows.turkish: Endişelenme, Bi Xi! Seni ve tableti SHOU-LAO’ya götüreceğiz… umarım…

rows.english: Not exactly a carriage ride through the park, but it'll have to do…
rows.turkish: Parkta atlı arabayla geziye çıkmak gibi sayılmaz ama idare edeceğiz…

rows.english: Something bothering you, Ben?
Heroes behind bars… This kind of thing never ends well…
rows.turkish: Parmaklıklar ardında kahramanlar… Bu işin sonu hiç hayra alamet değil…

rows.english: Even when you can't see me, I'll still make you believe.
That's what happens when you threaten my brother!
Let me guess. You're Namor's friends?
rows.turkish: Tahmin edelim bakalım. Namor’un dostları mısınız?

rows.english: I have a shield, but no complaints.
rows.turkish: Zaten kalkanım vardı ama şikâyetçi değilim.

rows.english: We're out of time.
We can't avoid this battle.
They can't hit what they can't see!
I'll fight for my family until the end.
The coast is almost clear, Spider!
One of Stephen's mystical portals…
There might not be vampires underwater yet, but there will be soon if we don't stop this.
rows.turkish: Vampirler henüz su altında olmayabilir ama bunu durdurmazsak yakında oraya da gelirler.

rows.english: Your turn to disappear.
Care to share some health?
Psionic Surge!
Let's go! If the Collector catches us, we become his newest prizes!
rows.turkish: Hadi gidelim! Koleksiyoner bizi yakalarsa, onun en yeni ödülleri oluruz!

rows.english: Franklin and Val would love to tear this place apart.
rows.turkish: Franklin ve Val burayı yerle bir etmeye bayılırdı.

rows.english: What am I? Invisible?
rows.turkish: Ne oldu? Beni gören yok mu?

rows.english: Not much. It's just been thrust into darkness and overrun by vampires.
rows.turkish: Karanlığa gömülüp vampir istilasına uğradı. Daha ne olsun?

rows.english: To be fair, no one ever does. I'm only seen when I want to be.
rows.turkish: Doğruya doğru, kimse de görmez zaten. Ben sadece istediğim zaman görünürüm.

rows.english: Who wants to see something fantastic…?
rows.turkish: Fantastik bir şey görmek isteyen var mı?..

rows.english: Disappear!
I used to love this park. But a vampire curse sure can change things…
rows.turkish: Eskiden bu parka âşıktım ama vampir laneti yüzünden her şey değişti…

rows.english: People think they can see right through me. I bet you've heard that before, too, Emma.
rows.turkish: İnsanlar hep içim dışım bir sanıyor. Eminim bunu sen de yaşamışsındır Emma.

rows.english: not yet. but keep talking, and that could change.
rows.turkish: Henüz değil ama konuşmaya devam edersen incitebilirim.

rows.english: I'd compliment you, Hulk, but Ben would get jealous.
rows.turkish: Benjamin kıskanmasa sana iltifat ederdim Hulk.

rows.english: Well, I'm not sure wooden stakes and holy water are going to cut it against symbiotes.
rows.turkish: Ah, emin değilim; ahşap kazıklar ve kutsal su sembiyotlara karşı işe yarayacak mı?

rows.english: You know you never stood a chance, right?
Someone's controlling me.
We need to disappear…
They'll never see me coming…
One less ankh, one less problem.
rows.turkish: Yaşam çarmıhı da gidince bir derdimiz azaldı.

rows.english: Well, this is a different kind of friendly neighborhood…
rows.turkish: Hımm, burası bizim Örümcek Adam’ın mahallesine benzemiyor…

rows.english: Just keep focused, Spider-Zero. We've got you.
rows.turkish: Sen işine odaklan Spider-Zero. Seni yarı yolda bırakmayız.

rows.english: You have no clue how long I've wanted to do that, Namor.
rows.turkish: Bunu yapmak için ne kadar beklediğimi bilemezsin Namor.

rows.english: How are you?
I was getting worried.
Nothing's getting through now.
We can capture this zone.
Our path to victory is clear. Let's go… For Wakanda!
rows.turkish: Zafere giden yol belli. Hadi gidelim… Wakanda için!

rows.english: Benjamin J. Grimm. You should know by now that I'm far from helpless!
rows.turkish: Benjamin J. Grimm. Kendimi savunabileceğimi gayet iyi biliyorsun!

rows.english: You forced my hand.
Quite a display, Jubilee!
Keep pushing ahead! We have to deliver The Book of the Iron Fist!
rows.turkish: İleriye doğru itmeye devam edin! Iron Fist’in Kitabı’nı teslim etmeliyiz!

rows.english: A little help please?
Thank you.
Not enough force yet…
As usual, Namor only grossed me out.
rows.turkish: Namor her zamanki gibi midemi bulandırmayı başardı.

rows.english: I'm not getting any better.
Over here! I can heal you!
Better than ever!
Help me defend this spot.
Fading… fast…
Force field, good to go!
Right… Saving the world from cosmic annihilation can be such a bore…
rows.turkish: Haklısın… Dünyayı kozmik yıkımdan kurtarmak çok sıkıcı olabiliyor…

rows.english: We'd better retreat.
That's three!
We need to get Knull's essence beneath the surface.
rows.turkish: Knull’un özünü yüzeyin altına götürmemiz şart.

rows.english: Shields up!
We really could've used a mind like yours, Bruce…
rows.turkish: O aklına çok ihtiyacımız vardı Bruce…

rows.english: Moon Knight's ankh, I presume?
rows.turkish: Sanıyorum Moon Knight'ın yaşam çarmıhı bu.

rows.english: How's that for a vanishing act, Stephen?
rows.turkish: Bu gözden kaybolma numarası nasılmış Stephen?

rows.english: If we get to the castle, we can break this curse!
Clearly, you needed some help.
I'm not the type who fades quietly into the background.
rows.turkish: Öyle sessizce gözden kaybolan birisi değilimdir.

rows.english: Guess it's time for us to head underground.
rows.turkish: Artık yerin altına inmemizin zamanı geldi demek ki.

rows.english: Who wants to see something fantastic…?
rows.turkish: Fantastik bir şey görmek isteyen var mı?..

rows.english: Shields up!
